model.description: ID of the model the scores belong to; the sheet slug equals the model slug

scores.description: one entry per observed value; the same benchmark may appear twice when two sources report different values

benchmark.description: ID of the benchmark that produced the value

value.description: the value exactly as its source states it; never rescaled

scale.description: percent runs from 0 to 100, fraction from 0 to 1

observed_on.description: date the value was recorded in the Atlas when the source gives none

self_reported.description: true when the vendor published the value itself, not an independent re-run

method.description: how it was measured, as the source states it (shots, metric, variant)

note.description: caveat on this value, as written by the source record it came from
